thread:
maria_cs: Quick kickoff for Asterion dedicated bring-up — tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need confirmed quota + autoscale params before we start warmup. Renewal flagged in QBR, so we want a clean 2-hour smoke and a documented fallback.

devon_se: On it. Customer asked for 250 rps baseline and 500 rps burst. Can we do warm cache strategy (prefix caching) and a 10m burst window?

alex_eng: Recommend baseline 200 rps on 3 GPUs, burst to 600 rps for 10m using step-scaling (+1 GPU per 2x load). Enable KV prefix cache for top-50 prompts. Also suggest quantized fallback variant (3b-quant) for graceful degradation. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/asterion-bringup

katie_ops: Load test window scheduled 09:30-11:00 PT. I'll run staged ramps: 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% with soak. Load command will be the loadgen container.

infra-bot: reserve-bot: Reserved pool allocated: pool-asterion-01 -> 4 x A40-equivalent GPUs (pool id pool-asterion-01). ETA provisioning: ~8m.

devon_se: Thanks infra-bot. I'll provision canary route to pool-asterion-01 and set routing policy: prefer low-latency zone, fallback to quantized small if capacity constrained. Will also enable token-cost gauges for the account.

maria_cs: Reminder: CSM post-test sync at 11:15 PT to review results and renewal risk summary. Jen from sales please join for commercial signal.

jen_sales: I'll join 11:15. If perf is brittle vs SLO, let's have a short escalation play — we can propose a 3-month reserved uplift to stabilize unit economics.

alex_eng: Throttle tuning notes for the run: set per-tenant max_inflight=120, queue_timeout=45s, batching_window_ms=12. If we see OOMs, automatic fallback to model-v1-small with a 5s degrade-hold.

katie_ops: Load script (copied to shared bucket):
```
./tools/loadgen --targets pool-asterion-01 --profile asterion-peak --stages 25,50,75,100 --duration 600 --record-metrics --save-samples ./results/asterion-2026-03-24
```
Will tag the run as asterion-bringup-1765439999.

infra-bot: load-runner: Job 8823 started for asterion-bringup-1765439999. Collector endpoint: https://metrics.redwood.internal/jobs/8823

devon_se: During test I'll watch tail-latency (p90/p99), cold-start rate, and cache-hit ratio. If p99 > 2.5s for more than 3 consecutive minutes, we abort and pivot to smaller model.

maria_cs: Post-test asks: capture 10 sample prompts + rubriced quality checks from Asterion devs, and a short CS survey about perceived latency impact. I'll prepare the survey and the renewal risk slide.

katie_ops: Copying checklist to channel after provisioning completes. Will upload raw logs and the load-run summary to the shared folder.

maria_cs: Thank you — this should give us the evidence to resolve the renewal risk or escalate commercial options. See you all tomorrow.
